projection.source_carrier_path: <relative POSIX path from the projected Atom Carrier parent directory to its authoritative source Carrier>

preserved_source_payload: all source frontmatter except the added projection mapping

resolution_and_tool_boundary.source_frontier_digest: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON eligible Candidate records ordered by Source Layer, Atom ID, Atom revision, canonical relative Carrier path, and Carrier SHA-256
resolution_and_tool_boundary.dry_run: reports the complete deterministic conflict set and one deterministic Candidate resolution per conflict
resolution_and_tool_boundary.apply_gate: one durable unambiguous Operator approval in LOCAL_CONFIGURATION bound to each exact conflict and the exact source-frontier digest
resolution_and_tool_boundary.approval_failure: stale, partial, missing, ambiguous, or mismatched approval leaves generated output unchanged
resolution_and_tool_boundary.tool: CA-P-110 must implement and use COMPILE_APPLICABLE_METHODOLOGY with dry-run validation and staged atomic replacement of generated RMEDO output directories only

retrieval_and_regeneration.indexes: derive GOVERNS and DEPENDS_ON indexes mechanically on demand from generated projected Atom Carriers
retrieval_and_regeneration.deletion: generated RMEDO output directories may be deleted
retrieval_and_regeneration.regeneration: the resolved source frontier regenerates the complete tree without authority loss
